title: Practice screen shows the camera hint
situation: Two merge checks are failing on the latest commit. The build job was cancelled by its 25-minute time limit.
ask: Should a fresh run fix the failing checks?

options.label: Fix in a fresh run
options.gain: No one has to touch the branch.

reversalCost.how: Stop the run; the pull request stays open.

options.label: Take over the branch yourself
options.loss: Your afternoon goes to build failures.

reversalCost.how: Hand the branch back with a comment.

ifNoAnswer.happens: The pull request stays open and falls behind main.
